regions.today: Mostly cloudy, with a few light showers. Light to moderate northeasterly winds.
regions.tonight: Tonight, apart from a few isolated light showers, mainly across the east and south, it'll be a dry night with a mix of cloud and clear spells. Some mist and fog will form once again. Cold with lowest temperatures of 1 to 5 degrees generally, with some ground frost in mostly light east to northeasterly or variable breezes, a bit more of a moderate northeast breeze though in eastern and some southern parts, which means it won't be as cold here and will remain frost and fog free.
regions.tomorrow: A mix of cloud and limited bright or sunny spells. A few light showers may occur too. Cool with highest temperatures of 10 to 12 degrees and moderate easterly winds.
